annotation.title_clean: 介護ロボットの開発・普及の促進
annotation.title_en: Promotion of the Development and Dissemination of Care Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (厚生労働省)
named_instruments_referenced: Priority Areas for Robot Technology in Nursing Care
annotation.summary_en: Japan MHLW portal page on care robots, listing the development-demonstration-dissemination platform, priority areas set with METI, annual project reports (2015–2025), subsidies, tax and financing support, safety standards (ISO 13482, JIS), and adoption support such as care-fee incentives and trial loans to promote use of care robots in eldercare.
key_provisions_or_claims: MHLW and METI define 6 fields/13 items of priority areas for robot technology in nursing care
Platform for development, demonstration and dissemination of care robots with needs-seeds matching and consultation centres
Subsidies for care robot adoption via Regional Medical and Care Comprehensive Fund (up to 300k-1M yen per device)
Safety standards referenced: ISO 13482 and JIS B8445/8446/8456, JIS Y1001
Tax, low-interest loans and care-fee evaluation to incentivise robot adoption for productivity
